selection_rule: Use every already-opened sequence as development-prior. After excluding all of their conservative subject-prefix keys, choose the three smallest compressed data members with mutually disjoint remaining keys as untouched validation in ascending compressed-size order.
subject_key_rule: Use the sequence-name prefix before the underscore as a conservative leakage group. This prevents same-prefix reuse but does not prove participant or device independence.
lock_rules: No assigned validation member may be fetched or opened before candidate code, selected config, implementation hashes, and complete development output are committed.
Development ranking may use truth only according to BODY_HEADING_PROTOCOL.md.
Validation cannot change code, parameters, alignment, metrics, gates, or the selected candidate.
Every validation sequence and both 50/100 Hz runs must be reported; no failure may be silently dropped.
Official pretrained-model output cannot select the classical config and cannot count as untouched evidence because the official README states that released models were trained on the entire dataset.
